definitions.explanation: A yellowish green, like young leaves and fresh shoots. {黄緑|きみどり} alone means the same color; adding {色|いろ} makes it explicitly "the color."

examples.japanese: {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新芽|しんめ}→新芽：13028_shinme⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黄緑色|きみどりいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{木|き}の{芽|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}き→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄緑色|きみどりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The buds came out and the whole mountain turned yellow-green.

notes:
A yellowish green, the color of new leaves and fresh shoots. Interchangeable with ⟦{黄緑|きみどり}→黄緑：15605_kimidori⟧; the ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ simply makes "color" explicit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: yellow-green leaves
- {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed yellow-green

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黄緑|きみどり}→黄緑：15605_kimidori⟧: yellow-green — the same color, without ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧
